pairing.task: does the text contain a CREDIT_CARD? Positive when the row carries an ai4privacy 'CREDITCARDNUMBER' span.

detector.configuration: AnalyzerEngine() with no arguments -- the stock recognizer registry and the default spaCy en_core_web_lg NLP engine. analyze(text, language='en', entities=[<one entity>]). No threshold is passed, so the engine's own default applies; the item score is the maximum confidence Presidio returns for that entity, or 0.0 when it returns nothing.

dataset.note: Every row contains PII, so a 'contains any PII' task on it is single-class and unbounded. Tasks are defined per entity type from the dataset's own span labels. DECISIONS 139.

criterion.name: lift_holds
criterion.registered: Phase 0 D6, unchanged for third parties (Phase 3 D35)

neutrality: This detector was run at its documented default configuration and was not tuned for this evaluation. A refusal at a given budget is a statement about what this dataset can support at that budget, not about the detector's quality. Phase 3 D34, D36.

estimator.certification: Clopper-Pearson one-sided upper bound via certify_fpr
estimator.interval: percentile bootstrap over questions; lift inherits recall's interval divided by the measured flag rate

cost_axis.unit: judge calls per 1000 requests, on this envelope
cost_axis.caveat: flag rate is measured at base rate 0.0645; this is not a production cost projection (DECISIONS 132)
